description: The staircase EW-residual conjecture (content/.../mass-theory/staircase-ew-residual.md) computes entirely in the Temperley-Lieb kernel. rho_k = (k, k-1, ..., 1) has EXACTLY k rows, so the Schur-Weyl row cap gives N_min(rho_k) = k, and at the framework's fibre N = 2 only k = 2 is physical — which is precisely the case the block itself calls UNTESTABLE ('the word collapses to length 0'). Its two empirically-loaded cases are k = 3 (rho_3 = (3,2,1), 3 rows, the cot(theta_W) 2.19 % -> 0.13 % claim) and k = 4 (4 rows). Measured: |omega_(3,2,1)| < 2e-16 at n = 6 under convention D against a minimum 7.6e-2 over the <=2-row shapes, with 720 = 6! total and 132 = Catalan(6) = dim TL_6 visible — so (3,2,1) is in the kernel of H_6(q) -> TL_6(q) and contributes nothing to any trace the framework computes. NOT a refutation: the Specht modules exist for every k and the eigenvalue ratio is not challenged; what is in question is what the empirical content can mean. Downstream Lean is unaffected — the block axiomatises the conjecture as a hypothesis-only class. Same defect qou-i9gk closed against Step 27, surfacing independently in the electroweak sector.

assertions.name: staircase_rho_k_has_exactly_k_rows_so_only_k2_is_physical
assertions.detail: rho_k = (k, k-1, ..., 1) has exactly k rows, so the Schur-Weyl row cap gives N_min(rho_k) = k. At the framework's fibre dimension N = 2 — which lem:feynman-eigenbasis-decomposition places in the INDEX SET of the mass channel's decomposition — only k = 2 is physical. The conjecture is stated 'for every k >= 2'; the row cap says that quantifier has exactly one physical instance

assertions.name: every_empirically_loaded_case_is_outside_the_N2_space
assertions.detail: the block's empirical content is k = 3 (closes cot(theta_W) from 2.19 % to 0.13 %) and k = 4 (pairwise ratio, 0.14 %); both have 3 and 4 rows. Its only <=2-row case, k = 2, it calls UNTESTABLE itself — 'the word collapses to length 0 ... renders the case untestable'. So every case carrying a physical number sits outside the N = 2 space, and the one case inside it has no matrix to inspect
